Context caching price Free of charge $0.025 / 1,000,000 tokens (text/image/video)
$0.175 / 1,000,000 tokens (audio)
sources.supports: Google's pricing page snapshot from 2025-06-16 listed Gemini 2.0 Flash context caching at $0.025 per million text/image/video tokens, before the models.dev schema change.
The same pre-change Google pricing page lists standard input at $0.10 per million text/image/video tokens.
The same pre-change Google pricing page lists standard output at $0.40 per million tokens.

notes: Google's own pricing page already listed the $0.025 per million text/image/video context caching rate on 2025-06-16, so the earlier models.dev omission was a catalog error rather than a provider price change. This establishes the official rate during the earlier period; it does not establish a provider effective date for the catalog correction.
